Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: zhangchao
Message:
feat: add Tkinter desktop GUI

- app/gui/: start with python -m app.gui; unlock or create a keystore,
  then My files (review requests, approve after checking the requester's
  key fingerprint, reject, revoke, deactivate), Protect a file (encrypt,
  sign, upload and register, step by step), Browse files (request access,
  live status), Retrieve and verify (authorized key info, V1-V6, key
  recovery, decryption, save), Activity (events, CSV export) and Account
- app/gui/app.py, worker.py: chain calls run off the Tk thread; one
  transaction at a time with pending, confirmed and failed toasts; chain
  polling refreshes the pages and tells requesters about decisions
- app/gui/widgets.py, layout.py, feedback.py: canvas-drawn controls, lists,
  step chains, toasts and banners, no ttk theme
- app/gui/demo_view.py: Security demo tab (--demo or SFS_DEMO=1) that
  tampers with stored objects and sends an unauthorized approve
- tests/unit/test_gui_format.py: text formatting helpers
- tests/integration/test_gui_demo.py: each tamper case fails the expected
  V checks; the unauthorized approve reverts with NotFileOwner

Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: zhangchao
Message:
feat: add chain client, storage, owner/requester workflows

- app/config.py: per-network settings from .env.<network>, plus STORAGE_DIR
- app/storage/: content-addressed local object store that simulates untrusted
  cloud storage; strict name checks, atomic writes, size limits
- app/chain/: web3 client with typed views and locally signed transactions,
  custom-error decoding into readable messages (RPC URL never shown),
  incremental event scanning and CSV export for the Activity Log
- app/services/: Session and key registration (account.py), Protect &
  Register and approve/reject/revoke (owner.py), catalogue, request and
  retrieve (requester.py), V1-V6 checks as pure functions (verification.py)
- tests/integration/: starts a throwaway Anvil per session; happy path,
  reject and revoke branches, tamper detection, timeout and S14/S15 cases
- tests/unit/: storage, config, revert decoding, event log, V1-V6 pipeline
- .gitignore: anchor storage/ to the root so app/storage/ is tracked
